settings.label: WhatsApp order number
settings.info: Country code first, digits only, for example 923001234567. It is used only inside WhatsApp links and is never printed on the page.

settings.label: Support email
settings.info: Leave empty to use the store email.

settings.label: Announcement bar text
settings.info: Shown first in the moving notice bar. Leave empty to hide.

settings.label: Lines shown in the shop
settings.info: Comma separated: Men, Women, Kids. Products tagged with a line not listed here stay in Shopify but are hidden from the shop. A line with no products is hidden too.

settings.content: These numbers are what the shop shows. The real charge comes from Settings > Shipping and delivery and your discounts in the Shopify admin, so keep both the same.

settings.label: Free delivery from this many pairs
Show low stock from this many pairs

settings.content: How the home page reads in Google results. Product and collection titles are set on each product and collection under Search engine listing.

settings.label: Home page title
settings.default: Men's Leather Shoes & Sneakers in Pakistan | DAUR Supply

settings.label: Home page description
settings.default: Men's leather shoes, sneakers, chelsea boots and casual shoes, crafted in Pakistan and finished with the DAUR mark. Cash on Delivery to every city, free delivery on 2 pairs.

settings.label: Google Search Console verification code
settings.info: Paste only the content value of the HTML tag Google gives you.

settings.label: Link preview image
settings.info: Shown when a page link is shared on WhatsApp, Facebook or Instagram and the page has no photo of its own. Best size 1200 x 630 px. Left empty, the built in DAUR share image is used. The Social sharing image in Online Store > Preferences takes priority over this.

settings.label: Microsoft Clarity project ID
settings.info: From clarity.microsoft.com, for example z6zmhh4wyo. Clarity records how visitors scroll and click; mention it in your privacy policy. Leave empty to turn it off.
